title: Cloud Billing adds Agent/Task model with breaking changes
summary: The Cloud Billing API is shifting toward an asynchronous, agent-based interaction model with new message and task resources, while enforcing stricter parameter requirements.
details: This update introduces a significant new interaction paradigm via the `message` and `tasks` resources. Developers can now use `message.send` for blocking agent requests and `message.stream` for real-time event streams. To manage these operations, new task methods including `tasks.get`, `tasks.cancel`, and `tasks.subscribe` (a streaming listener) have been added. Note that this is a breaking change: the `name` and `parent` parameters are now strictly required across several methods. Additionally, `tasks.get` now supports a `historyLength` parameter and an experimental `tenant` parameter for multi-tenant environments.
